secretHandling.officialCli: The upstream CLI currently accepts App Secret via -s/--app-secret arguments.
secretHandling.risk: The upstream child process still receives the secret as an argument and trusted local process inspection may reveal it.
secretHandling.requiredMitigation: Codex config forwards only process environment variable names to the local wrapper. The wrapper never logs values, validates the locked package metadata and JavaScript entrypoint, invokes Node directly instead of a cmd.exe shim, and refuses to enable the server if credentials or package files are absent.
secretHandling.publicTemplateRule: The public template contains placeholders and environment variable names only and remains disabled.

servers.disableRule: Set enabled=false or remove the generated [mcp_servers.feishu] block; do not delete unrelated MCP entries.
